archimate:Capability.name: 1.4. Analysis
archimate:Capability.documentation: Description: The ability to examine and understand data before it is disseminated. Explanation: Within statistical institutes, statistical analysis is also known as statistical research in which certain connections or conclusions can be drawn on the basis of relationships (such as correlation). Source: GSBPM 5.2, Analyse Link : https://unece.github.io/GSBPM-5.2/#analyse-phase
